claims.text: Yes, i-on's liability is capped. Its liability for damages to the Customer, for any cause and under any form of action, is limited to one month's fees plus the remaining portion of any prepaid fees.

citations.quote: i-on's liability for damages to the Customer for any cause whatsoever, regardless of the form of action, and whether in contract or in tort, including negligence, shall be limited to one (1) month's fees and the remaining portion of any prepaid fees.

claims.text: A separate exclusion bars recovery of lost profits and consequential damages. i-on will not be liable for these, even if it was advised of the possibility of such damages.

citations.quote: i-on will not be liable under any circumstances for any lost profits or other consequential damages, even if i-on has been advised as to the possibility of such damages.

claims.text: The sources do not list any carve-outs from the cap itself (for example, for gross negligence or indemnity obligations). The cap is stated without exceptions.

citations.quote: shall be limited to one (1) month's fees and the remaining portion of any prepaid fees.

claims.text: The Customer's indemnification obligation is a separate provision and is not framed as subject to the cap. The Customer agrees to indemnify and hold i-on harmless against related lawsuits, claims, and damages, and to reimburse i-on's legal expenses.

citations.quote: The Customer agrees to indemnify and hold harmless i-on, against any lawsuits, claims, damages, or liabilities
and will reimburse i-on for all legal and other expenses, including attorney's fees

claims.text: The Customer also agrees to hold i-on harmless for service interruptions outside i-on's described responsibilities, and for data loss, provided i-on maintains reasonable protective steps.

citations.quote: agrees to hold i-on harmless for any interruptions in service to the Hosted Site
agrees to hold i-on harmless for any such data loss for the Hosted Site, provided that i-on maintains reasonable steps as described in this Agreement to protect against such data loss.
